name: figma-harness
description: Code-governed Figma workspace: a plugin, a swappable design system, an example app, and the offline harness that verifies them

scripts.guard: pnpm run guard:architecture && pnpm run guard:authoring && pnpm run guard:flows && pnpm run guard:hygiene
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives packages design-systems apps templates plugin
scripts.test: tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 packages/*/tests/*.test.ts design-systems/*/tests/*.test.ts apps/*/tests/*.test.ts templates/*/tests/*.test.ts plugin/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.smoke:figma:preflight: pnpm run build:check && pnpm run render:fonts:check && pnpm run design:check && pnpm run design:components:check
scripts.verify: pnpm run guard && pnpm run build:check && pnpm run check:generated && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run each render:fonts:check && pnpm run each audit && pnpm run each audit:contrast && pnpm run each audit:a11y && pnpm run each audit:theme && pnpm run each design:check && pnpm run each design:components:check
